thread:
mara: Heads up — getting a flood of pages from retrofit-notifier (old integration) since ~02:12 UTC. They look like duplicates, same PD incident id repeated. Anyone else seeing this?

ben: Seeing it. 5 pages in the last 3 minutes for the same customer. Paging channel noisy. Probably the adapter restarted during deploy.

incident-bot: alert: integration 'retrofit-notifier' delivered 12 pages to /incidents/pager at 2025-11-12T02:12:07Z. Rate limiting not triggered.

oncall-duty: I got paged and acked once, then got 3 more pages. I had to silence. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

ian: @mara please check the notification-adapter logs. We deployed the "retrofit" adapter migration yesterday; the migration swapped webhook registrations but left a legacy shim enabled.

mara: tailing adapter logs shows repeated POST 200 responses with different delivery ids. There's a retry loop: the error handler treats 202 as a transient failure and requeues, but the new webhook returns 202 intentionally. Looks like last PR changed the success code expectation.

ben: Confirmed. New behavior treats 202 as "retry" which causes duplicate deliveries. Opening hotfix.

mara: Mitigation — paused retrofit-notifier via ops command: `/ops integration pause retrofit-notifier` (executed at 1749804400). Also scaled deployment down as emergency: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment retrofit-adapter --replicas=0`

oncall-duty: Pages stopped after pause. Thanks. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: audit: pause command executed by mara at 1749804402. Adapter pods scaled to 0 at 1749804410.

ian: Hotfix PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5827 — fixes 202 handling and strengthens idempotency key checks.

ben: Rolling patch to staging now, then prod if green. ETA ~15m.

mara: Customer impact: affected customers were internal test org + 3 external customers using the legacy webhook shim. They saw duplicate pages; no data loss, just noise and potential operational confusion. Support tickets created and owners notified.

oncall-duty: Action items off the thread: 1) revert deprecated webhook path support by default, 2) add monitoring rule for identical PD incident IDs within a short window, 3) update runbook for adapter migrations and preflight checks.

ian: I'll own alerting rule + runbook PR. Ben will own patch rollout. Mara to draft customer comms + postmortem.

mara: Will draft incident summary & put full postmortem in #postmortems. Also will schedule a 30-min retro with infra + svc owners. :memo: 

sre-ops-bot: reminder: please run `tools/integration-check --retrofit-notifier` after patch is live to verify idempotency headers.

ben: Patch merged to main and rolled to prod at 1749804600 — monitoring shows no new duplicate deliveries. Leaving adapter paused until runbook changes shipped.

oncall-duty: Marking incident as mitigated, will not close until customer comms are sent.

mara: Thanks everyone — follow-ups tracked in the ticket and I'll attach logs/trace for the postmortem. :eyes:
